summary: PDF pages 353-388 of the German Abramelin print (printed pages 349-375 plus back matter). They carry chapters 15 through 30 of Book IV, complete, and the end of Book IV: chapter 15 (p353), 16 (p354-356), 17 (p357-358), 18 (p358-359), 19 (p360-362), 20 (p362-365), 21 (p365-366), 22 (p366-367), 23 (p367-368), 24 (p368-369), 25 (p369), 26 (p370), 27 (p371-375), 28 (p376), 29 (p377), 30 (p378). Book IV ends on PDF p379 (printed 375) with a 'Finis' line and a colophon; PDF p380-388 are back matter (blank leaves, a two-column key of signs on p381, a publisher's advertisement on p382, a library stamp, the back cover). LAYOUT: there are no ruled letter grids in this range. Each numbered square is printed as running text - an inline row of period-separated letter groups that wraps over one to four bands directly beneath its caption. Captions and squares therefore alternate strictly top to bottom in a single full-width column; nothing sits side by side except the two-column sign table on p381. Each chapter opens with a stock Latin line, a two-to-three-band display heading, and a one-to-two-band chapter purpose statement, and closes with a printer's ornament. Two layout exceptions worth crop care: on p364 band 1 holds caption 10 and the first line of square 10 stacked inside one band (they cannot be separated by x, only by a vertical split of the band), and square 14 of chapter 27 is split across the p372/p373 page break.
